new_training.purpose: Behavior tuning after two isolated exact-packet reviews

development_generation.purpose: Baseline/candidate answer comparison on separate fictional constructs

owner_browser_questions.purpose: Actual product acceptance, including generated legal answers

selection.rule: Lowest finite validation loss measured by reloading exact saved bytes; ties prefer earlier

development_acceptance: Existing development and controller tests pass without protected-bank reads
Generated answers retain scope, conditions, relevant evidence and needed clarification
No material regression on the separate development generation cases
Q1 and distinct legal/browser variants deliver substantively adequate cited answers
Real HTTP/WS journeys, retries, cancellation, history and user separation pass

custodian_requirements: Separate custodian holds questions and answers outside implementer and trainer access
Use novel facts, phrasing and source combinations across pension topics, missing evidence, private-record boundaries and safety negatives
Do not derive cases or answers from exposed failures or the new training/validation targets
Bind exact frozen model, corpus, application, configuration and reviewer identities
One authorized run; preserve failures and retire exposed cases from unseen status
Any substantive post-freeze change invalidates downstream evidence
